problem: OfflineRL must propagate reward through suboptimal trajectory fragments without exploiting unsupported action values.
contribution: ImplicitQ-Learning performs multi-step dynamic programming using only dataset actions, then extracts a policy by advantage-weighted regression.
algorithm: Fit a value function to an upper expectile of dataset-actionQvalues. RegressQto reward plus next-stateV, separating action variability from lucky stochastic transitions. Extract a policy with exponentially advantage-weighted behavior cloning.
observations: Dataset states inD4RL locomotion,AntMaze,Adroit andKitchen; no robotic camera representation is intrinsic to the method.
actions: Continuous dataset actions; value learning avoids sampling out-of-distribution actions, and policy extraction fits action likelihoods.
embodiment_and_data: OfflineMuJoCo/maze/manipulation benchmarks plus a controlled stochasticmaze illustration and subsequent online fine-tuning.
experiments: Test multi-step trajectory stitching, compare offline normalized returns and measure improvement after1milliononline steps; runtime is reported onGTX1080, notNX.
limitations: Improvement remains limited by dataset support and valid reward/transition semantics. Expectile and advantage-temperature choices matter; a large learnedQis not independent outcome evidence.
hardware_adaptation: COMPARE only if meaningful reward-labelled offline transitions exist. Failed and intervention episodes can supportRLanalysis, but should not be indiscriminately relabelled as expertBCtargets.
algorithm_detail: SeparateVexpectile regression prevents high targets caused only by lucky next-state stochasticity;Quses an ordinary squaredBellman residual. Policy extraction is weighted regression, distinct from critic max-action querying and from unconditional replay of successful demonstrations.
integration_contract: Immutable dataset/reward-model versions, proper terminal/truncated flags, dataset-supported action semantics and train-only normalizers are required. Compare offline and online phases with separately counted interactions.
license_evidence: PrimaryarXivPDF andmethods/tables examined; no upstream sourcecode license or execution was verified, so no code reusepermission is inferred.
required_experiments: Offline reward/transition audit; equal-dataBC/CQLcomparison; action-support checks; independent closed-loop evaluation with fresh seeds; target-only versus transferred-data ablation under matchedtargetdata.
difference_from_explorer: Already learns from suboptimal offline data through dynamic programming; this does not create a causaldiagnostic or cross-robot effectsrepresentation by itself.
